name: MultAdd.Cube.layer_eq_zero
statement: ∀ n k, n < k → layer n k = 0
proof:
| 0, 0, h => absurd h (by decide)
  | 0, _ + 1, _ => rfl
  | _ + 1, 0, h => absurd h (by omega)
  | n + 1, k + 1, h => by
    rw [layer_succ_succ, layer_eq_zero n k (by omega), layer_eq_zero n (k + 1) (by omega)]

name: MultAdd.Cube.absorb
doc: Absorption: (k+1)·C(n+1,k+1) = (n+1)·C(n,k).
statement: ∀ n k, (k + 1) * layer (n + 1) (k + 1) = (n + 1) * layer n k
proof:
by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro k
    cases k with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ k => simp [layer]
  | succ n ih =>
    intro k
    cases k with
    | zero =>
      have h := ih 0
      rw [layer_succ_succ]
      simp only [layer_zero_right] at h ⊢
      omega
    | succ j =>
      have h1 := ih j
      have h2 := ih (j + 1)
      have hp := layer_succ_succ n j
      rw [layer_succ_succ (n + 1) (j + 1)]
      generalize layer (n + 1) (j + 1) = X at *
      generalize layer (n + 1) (j + 1 + 1) = Y at *
      generalize layer n j = A at *
      generalize layer n (j + 1) = B at *
      subst hp
      grind

name: MultAdd.Cube.fact_pos

name: MultAdd.Cube.layer_step
statement: (k + 1) * layer n (k + 1) = (n - k) * layer n k
proof:
by
  cases n with
  | zero =>
    rw [layer_eq_zero 0 (k + 1) (by omega)]; simp
  | succ m =>
    cases Nat.lt_or_ge m k with
    | inl h =>
      rw [layer_eq_zero (m + 1) (k + 1) (by omega)]
      have h0 : m + 1 - k = 0 := by omega
      rw [h0]; simp
    | inr h =>
      have ha := absorb m k
      have hp := layer_succ_succ m k
      cases k with
      | zero =>
        simp only [layer_zero_right, Nat.sub_zero] at *
        rw [hp] at ha
        generalize layer (m + 1) 1 = X at *
        generalize layer m 1 = B at *
        grind
      | succ j =>
         
        have ha2 := absorb m (j + 1)
        have hp2 := layer_succ_succ m (j + 1)
        rw [hp2] at ha2
        have hpj := layer_succ_succ m j
        have hsub : m + 1 - (j + 1) = m - j := by omega
        rw [hsub, hpj]
        have hab := absorb m j
        rw [hpj] at hab
        generalize layer m (j + 1 + 1) = C at *
        generalize layer m (j + 1) = B at *
        generalize layer m j = A at *
        have hmj : m = (m - j) + j := by omega
        generalize m - j = d at *
        subst hmj
        grind

doc: Ladder lemma: if each rung is the one below it run after one step of `s`, then rung j is the bottom rung run after j steps of `s`. On [1,2] the fused-linear rungs satisfy this with f x = b^x and s x = b^(x-1), which gives H_k(b,x) = b^(s^(k-3)(x)).
statement: ∀ j x, G j x = f (iter s j x)
proof:
| 0, x => by rw [h0]; rfl

name: FusedRate.grow
doc: Growth template: if each step multiplies the gap by at least p/q, then after j steps it is at least (p/q)^j times the start.
statement: ∀ j, p ^ j * d 0 ≤ q ^ j * d j
proof:
| 0 => by simp
  | j + 1 => by
      have ih := grow d p q h j
      have hj := h j
      calc p ^ (j + 1) * d 0 = p * (p ^ j * d 0) := by rw [Nat.pow_succ]; rw [Nat.mul_comm (p ^ j) p, Nat.mul_assoc]
        _ ≤ p * (q ^ j * d j) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left p ih
        _ = q ^ j * (p * d j) := by rw [← Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.mul_comm p (q ^ j), Nat.mul_assoc]
        _ ≤ q ^ j * (q * d (j + 1)) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hj
        _ = q ^ (j + 1) * d (j + 1) := by rw [Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_assoc]

name: MultAdd.E.layer_mul_fact
doc: **Picking with order.** C(n,k)·k! = n(n-1)…(n-k+1).
statement: ∀ k, layer n k * fact k = fall n k
proof:
| 0 => by simp [layer_zero_right, fact, fall]
  | k + 1 => by
    have ih := layer_mul_fact n k
    have hs := layer_step n k
    show layer n (k + 1) * ((k + 1) * fact k) = fall n k * (n - k)
    rw [← ih, ← Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.mul_comm (layer n (k+1)) (k+1), hs]
    generalize layer n k = A; generalize fact k = F; generalize n - k = d
    grind

name: MultAdd.E.collisions
doc: **Collisions are few.** n·nᵏ ≤ n·fall n k + C(k,2)·nᵏ: the ordered picks that repeat an axis number at most C(k,2)·nᵏ⁻¹.
statement: ∀ k, k ≤ n → n * n ^ k ≤ n * fall n k + tri k * n ^ k
proof:
| 0, _ => by simp [fall, tri]
  | k + 1, h => by
    have ih := collisions n k (by omega)
    have hF := fall_le_pow n k
    show n * (n ^ k * n) ≤ n * (fall n k * (n - k)) + (tri k + k) * (n ^ k * n)
    have hsplit : n = (n - k) + k := by omega
    have h1 : n * (n * n ^ k) ≤ n * (n * fall n k + tri k * n ^ k) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left n ih
    have h2 : n * (k * fall n k) ≤ n * (k * n ^ k) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left n (Nat.mul_le_mul_left k hF)
    generalize n ^ k = A at *
    generalize fall n k = F at *
    generalize n - k = d at *
    subst hsplit
    grind

name: MultAdd.E.bernoulli
doc: **Bernoulli, with room to spare.** (c+1)^(k+2) + (k+1)(c+1)^k ≤ c^(k+2) + (k+2)(c+1)^(k+1).

  | k + 1 => by
    have ih := bernoulli c k
    have h := Nat.mul_le_mul_left c ih

name: MultAdd.E.stair_nat_lt
doc: **The staircase climbs** (cleared of fractions): (n+1)^(2n+1) < nⁿ·(n+2)^(n+1) for n ≥ 1, i.e. (1+1/n)ⁿ < (1+1/(n+1))ⁿ⁺¹.
proof:
by
  have hb := bernoulli_strict ((m + 1) * (m + 3)) m
  have hc : (m + 1) * (m + 3) + 1 = (m + 2) ^ 2 := by grind
  rw [hc, ← Nat.pow_mul, ← Nat.pow_mul, ← Nat.pow_mul, Nat.mul_pow] at hb
  have e1 : (m + 2) ^ (2 * (m + 2)) = (m + 2) ^ (2 * m) * (m + 2) ^ 4 := by
    have : 2 * (m + 2) = 2 * m + 4 := by omega
    rw [this, Nat.pow_add]
  have e2 : (m + 2) ^ (2 * (m + 1)) = (m + 2) ^ (2 * m) * (m + 2) ^ 2 := by
    have : 2 * (m + 1) = 2 * m + 2 := by omega
    rw [this, Nat.pow_add]
  have e3 : (m + 2) ^ (2 * (m + 1) + 1) = (m + 2) ^ (2 * m) * (m + 2) ^ 3 := by
    have : 2 * (m + 1) + 1 = 2 * m + 3 := by omega
    rw [this, Nat.pow_add]
  have e4 : (m + 1) ^ (m + 2) = (m + 1) * (m + 1) ^ (m + 1) := by rw [Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_comm]
  rw [e1, e2, e4, Nat.mul_assoc (m + 1)] at hb
  rw [e3]
  have hQ : 0 < (m + 2) ^ (2 * m) := Nat.pow_pos (by omega)
  generalize (m + 2) ^ (2 * m) = Q at *
  generalize (m + 1) ^ (m + 1) * (m + 3) ^ (m + 2) = R at *
  have hb' : (m + 1) * (Q * (m + 2) ^ 3 + Q) ≤ (m + 1) * R := by
    grind
  have := Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left hb' (by omega)
  omega

name: MultAdd.E.binomial
doc: **The cube's corner count.** (1 + x)ⁿ = Σₖ C(n,k)·xᵏ.
statement: (1 + x) ^ n = rsum (fun k => (layer n k : Rat) * x ^ k) (n + 1)

by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [rsum, layer] <;> grind
  | succ n ih =>
    have hT : rsum (fun k => (layer n (k + 1) : Rat) * x ^ (k + 1)) (n + 1)
        = rsum (fun k => (layer n k : Rat) * x ^ k) (n + 1) - 1 := by
      rw [rsum_shift (fun k => (layer n k : Rat) * x ^ k), rsum, layer_eq_zero n (n + 1) (by omega)]
      simp [layer_zero_right] <;> grind
    have step : rsum (fun k => (layer (n + 1) k : Rat) * x ^ k) (n + 1 + 1)
        = x * rsum (fun k => (layer n k : Rat) * x ^ k) (n + 1)
          + rsum (fun k => (layer n k : Rat) * x ^ k) (n + 1) := by
      rw [rsum_shift]
      have e : (fun k => ((layer (n + 1) (k + 1) : Nat) : Rat) * x ^ (k + 1)) =
          (fun k => x * ((layer n k : Rat) * x ^ k) + (layer n (k + 1) : Rat) * x ^ (k + 1)) := by
        funext k; rw [layer_succ_succ, Rat.natCast_add, Rat.pow_succ]; grind
      rw [e, rsum_add, rsum_mul, hT]; simp [layer_zero_right]; grind
    rw [Rat.pow_succ, ih, step]; grind

name: MultAdd.E.wt_le
doc: **Each layer is at most 1/k!.** C(n,k)/nᵏ ≤ 1/k!.

name: MultAdd.E.wt_ge
doc: **Each layer is at least 1/k! minus its collisions.** 1/k! ≤ C(n,k)/nᵏ + C(k,2)/(n·k!).
statement: 1 / (fact k : Rat) ≤ wt n k + (tri k : Rat) / ((n : Rat) * (fact k : Rat))
proof:
by
  have hN0 : (0 : Rat) < (n : Rat) := Rat.natCast_pos.mpr (by omega)
  have hN : (n : Rat) ≠ 0 := Rat.ne_of_gt hN0
  have hK := fact_cast_pos k
  have hu := inv_pow_mul (n : Rat) hN k
  have hc : (n : Rat) * (n : Rat) ^ k ≤ (n : Rat) * ((layer n k : Rat) * (fact k : Rat)) + (tri k : Rat) * (n : Rat) ^ k := by
    have := Rat.natCast_le_natCast.mpr (collisions n k hk)
    rw [← layer_mul_fact] at this
    simp only [Rat.natCast_mul, Rat.natCast_add, Rat.natCast_pow] at this; exact this
  have hu0 : 0 ≤ (1 / (n : Rat)) ^ k := Rat.pow_nonneg (one_div_nonneg Rat.natCast_nonneg)
  have h := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc hu0
  have hK1 : 1 / (fact k : Rat) * (fact k : Rat) = 1 := Rat.div_mul_cancel (Rat.ne_of_gt hK)
  have hNK : 0 < (n : Rat) * (fact k : Rat) := Rat.mul_pos hN0 hK
  have key : (1 / (fact k : Rat) - wt n k) * ((n : Rat) * (fact k : Rat)) ≤ (tri k : Rat) := by
    unfold wt
    generalize (1 / (n : Rat)) ^ k = u at *
    generalize (n : Rat) ^ k = P at *
    generalize 1 / (fact k : Rat) = r at *
    generalize (layer n k : Rat) = C at *
    generalize (fact k : Rat) = K at *
    generalize (tri k : Rat) = T at *
    generalize (n : Rat) = N at *
    have e1 : N * P * u = N := by
      have : N * P * u = N * (u * P) := by grind
      rw [this, hu]; grind
    have e2 : (N * (C * K) + T * P) * u = N * C * K * u + T := by
      have : (N * (C * K) + T * P) * u = N * C * K * u + T * (u * P) := by grind
      rw [this, hu]; grind
    have e3 : (r - C * u) * (N * K) = N * (r * K) - N * C * K * u := by grind
    rw [e3, hK1]; rw [e1, e2] at h; grind
  have := le_div_of_mul_le hNK key
  grind

  have : (0 : Rat) < 2 / (2 : Rat) ^ N := (Rat.lt_div_iff hP).mpr (by grind)

name: MultAdd.E.s_le_u

name: MultAdd.E.u_step
doc: **The upper partner only comes down.** u (N+1) ≤ u N for N ≥ 1.
proof:
by
  have hF := fact_cast_pos N
  have hN1 : (1 : Rat) ≤ (N : Rat) := by
    have := Rat.natCast_le_natCast.mpr hN; simpa using this
  show rsum (fun k => 1 / (fact k : Rat)) (N + 1) + 1 / (fact (N + 1) : Rat)
      + 1 / ((fact (N + 1) : Rat) * ((N + 1 : Nat) : Rat))
      ≤ rsum (fun k => 1 / (fact k : Rat)) (N + 1) + 1 / ((fact N : Rat) * (N : Rat))
  have e : (fact (N + 1) : Rat) = ((N : Rat) + 1) * (fact N : Rat) := by
    show (((N + 1) * fact N : Nat) : Rat) = _
    rw [Rat.natCast_mul, Rat.natCast_add]; simp
  have e2 : ((N + 1 : Nat) : Rat) = (N : Rat) + 1 := by rw [Rat.natCast_add]; simp
  rw [e, e2]
  generalize (fact N : Rat) = F at *
  generalize (N : Rat) = x at *
  have hgoal : (1 / ((x + 1) * F) + 1 / ((x + 1) * F * (x + 1))) * (F * x) ≤ 1 := by
    have : (1 / ((x + 1) * F) + 1 / ((x + 1) * F * (x + 1))) * (F * x) = x * (x + 2) / ((x + 1) * (x + 1)) := by grind
    rw [this]
    have hpos : (0 : Rat) < (x + 1) * (x + 1) := Rat.mul_pos (by grind) (by grind)
    exact Rat.not_lt.mp (fun h => by have := (Rat.lt_div_iff hpos).mp h; grind)
  have hFx : 0 < F * x := Rat.mul_pos hF (by grind)
  have := le_div_of_mul_le hFx hgoal
  grind

name: MultAdd.E.s_le_stair
doc: **The floor.** For n ≥ N, the staircase is within 3·C(N,2)/n of s N.
statement: s N - 3 * (tri N : Rat) / (n : Rat) ≤ stair n
proof:
by
  have hN0 : (0 : Rat) < (n : Rat) := Rat.natCast_pos.mpr (by omega)
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c : Rat, c = (tri N : Rat) / (n : Rat) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hc0 : 0 ≤ c := by
    rw [hc]; exact le_div_of_mul_le hN0 (by have : (0:Rat) ≤ (tri N : Rat) := Rat.natCast_nonneg; grind)
   
  have h1 : rsum (wt n) (N + 1) ≤ stair n := by
    rw [stair_eq_cube]; exact rsum_mono _ (wt_nonneg n) (by omega)
   
  have h2 : rsum (fun k => 1 / (fact k : Rat) + (-c) * (1 / (fact k : Rat))) (N + 1) ≤ rsum (wt n) (N + 1) := by
    apply rsum_le
    intro k hk
    have hg := wt_ge n k hn (by omega)
    have hK := fact_cast_pos k
    have ht : (tri k : Rat) / ((n : Rat) * (fact k : Rat)) ≤ c * (1 / (fact k : Rat)) := by
      have htk : (tri k : Rat) ≤ (tri N : Rat) := Rat.natCast_le_natCast.mpr (tri_mono (by omega))
      apply Rat.not_lt.mp
      intro hlt
      have hNK : 0 < (n : Rat) * (fact k : Rat) := Rat.mul_pos hN0 hK
      have := (Rat.lt_div_iff hNK).mp hlt
      have e : c * (1 / (fact k : Rat)) * ((n : Rat) * (fact k : Rat)) = (tri N : Rat) := by
        rw [hc]; grind
      grind
    grind
  rw [rsum_add, rsum_mul] at h2
  have hs : rsum (fun k => 1 / (fact k : Rat)) (N + 1) = s N := rfl
  rw [hs] at h2
  have h3 := s_lt_three N
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ s N := rsum_nonneg _ _ (fun k _ => one_div_nonneg (Rat.le_of_lt (fact_cast_pos k)))
  have h4 : c * s N ≤ c * 3 := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Rat.le_of_lt h3) hc0
  have e : 3 * (tri N : Rat) / (n : Rat) = c * 3 := by rw [hc]; grind
  rw [e]
  grind

name: MultAdd.E.stair_lt_succ
doc: **The staircase climbs.** (1 + 1/n)ⁿ < (1 + 1/(n+1))ⁿ⁺¹ for n ≥ 1.
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, n = m + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
  have hA : stair (m + 1) * ((m + 1 : Nat) : Rat) ^ (m + 1) = ((m + 2 : Nat) : Rat) ^ (m + 1) := by
    unfold stair; rw [← mul_pow']; congr 1
    have : ((m + 1 : Nat) : Rat) ≠ 0 := natcast_ne (by omega)
    rw [Rat.natCast_add, Rat.natCast_add] at *; grind
  have hB : stair (m + 2) * ((m + 2 : Nat) : Rat) ^ (m + 2) = ((m + 3 : Nat) : Rat) ^ (m + 2) := by
    unfold stair; rw [← mul_pow']; congr 1
    have : ((m + 2 : Nat) : Rat) ≠ 0 := natcast_ne (by omega)
    rw [Rat.natCast_add, Rat.natCast_add] at *; grind
  have hnat := Rat.natCast_lt_natCast.mpr (stair_nat_lt m)
  simp only [Rat.natCast_mul, Rat.natCast_pow] at hnat
  have e : ((m + 2 : Nat) : Rat) ^ (2 * (m + 1) + 1) = ((m + 2 : Nat) : Rat) ^ (m + 1) * ((m + 2 : Nat) : Rat) ^ (m + 2) := by
    rw [← pow_add']; congr 1; omega
  rw [e, ← hA, ← hB] at hnat
  have hP : (0 : Rat) < ((m + 1 : Nat) : Rat) ^ (m + 1) := Rat.pow_pos (Rat.natCast_pos.mpr (by omega))
  have hS : (0 : Rat) < ((m + 2 : Nat) : Rat) ^ (m + 2) := Rat.pow_pos (Rat.natCast_pos.mpr (by omega))
  have hPS := Rat.mul_pos hP hS
  apply Rat.lt_of_mul_lt_mul_right (c := ((m + 1 : Nat) : Rat) ^ (m + 1) * ((m + 2 : Nat) : Rat) ^ (m + 2)) _ (Rat.le_of_lt hPS)
  generalize ((m + 1 : Nat) : Rat) ^ (m + 1) = P at *
  generalize ((m + 2 : Nat) : Rat) ^ (m + 2) = S at *
  generalize ((m + 3 : Nat) : Rat) ^ (m + 2) = T at *
  grind

name: FinanceMultAdd.am_hm
proof:
by
  intro c hc
  have key : x * v + y * u - 2 = x * y * ((u - v) * (u - v)) := by grind
  have hx0 : 0 ≤ x := by
    rcases (@Rat.le_total 0 x) with h | h
    · exact h
    · have := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Rat.le_of_lt hu) (by grind : (0:Rat) ≤ -x); grind
  have hy0 : 0 ≤ y := by
    rcases (@Rat.le_total 0 y) with h | h
    · exact h
    · have := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Rat.le_of_lt hv) (by grind : (0:Rat) ≤ -y); grind
  have p := Rat.mul_nonneg (Rat.mul_nonneg hx0 hy0) (sq_nonneg' (u - v))
   
  have e : (x + y) * (u + v) = x * u + y * v + (x * v + y * u) := by grind
  have p' : 0 ≤ x * v + y * u - 2 := by rw [key]; exact p
  have h4 : 4 ≤ (x + y) * (u + v) := by rw [e, hx, hy]; grind
  have hc0 : 0 ≤ c := by
    rcases (@Rat.le_total 0 c) with h | h
    · exact h
    · have := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by grind : (0:Rat) ≤ (u + v) / 2) (by grind : (0:Rat) ≤ -c); grind
  have h5 := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h4 hc0
  have e2 : c * ((x + y) * (u + v)) = (x + y) * (2 * (c * ((u + v) / 2))) := by grind
  rw [e2, hc] at h5
  grind

  let c := 1 / ((u + v) / 2)

  have hcn : c ^ n * ((u + v) / 2) ^ n = 1 := by rw [← mul_pow', hc]; exact one_pow' n
  have hdc : d = c ^ n := by
    have : d * ((u + v) / 2) ^ n * c ^ n = c ^ n * ((u + v) / 2) ^ n * d := by grind
    grind
  have hx0 : 0 ≤ x := by
    rcases (@Rat.le_total 0 x) with h | h
    · exact h
    · have := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Rat.le_of_lt hu) (by grind : (0:Rat) ≤ -x); grind
  have hy0 : 0 ≤ y := by
    rcases (@Rat.le_total 0 y) with h | h
    · exact h
    · have := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Rat.le_of_lt hv) (by grind : (0:Rat) ≤ -y); grind
  have h1 := am_hm hu hv hx hy c hc
  have hc0 : 0 ≤ c := by
    rcases (@Rat.le_total 0 c) with h | h
    · exact h
    · have := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Rat.le_of_lt hpos) (by grind : (0:Rat) ≤ -c); grind
  have h2 := pow_le_pow' hc0 h1 n
  have h3 := power_mean hx0 hy0 n
  grind

name: MultAdd.Cube.lucas_step
doc: **Lucas, one step.** C(n,k) ≡ C(n div p, k div p) · C(n mod p, k mod p).
statement: ∀ n k, MEq p (layer n k) (blockCount p n k)
proof:
by
  have hp0 : 0 < p := by have := hp.1; omega
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro k
    cases k with
    | zero =>
      unfold blockCount
      rw [Nat.zero_div, Nat.zero_mod]; exact MEq.refl _ _
    | succ k =>
      unfold blockCount
      rw [Nat.zero_div, Nat.zero_mod]
      have hk := Nat.div_add_mod (k + 1) p
      by_cases h : (k + 1) % p = 0
      · have hq : (k + 1) / p ≠ 0 := by
          intro hq; rw [hq, h] at hk; simp at hk
        simp only [layer_zero_left ((k + 1) / p), hq, ↓reduceIte]
        simp [layer]; exact MEq.refl _ _
      · simp only [layer_zero_left ((k + 1) % p), h, ↓reduceIte]
        simp [layer]; exact MEq.refl _ _
  | succ n ih =>
    intro k
    obtain ⟨a, b, hb, hn⟩ : ∃ a b, b < p ∧ n = p * a + b :=
      ⟨n / p, n % p, Nat.mod_lt n hp0, (Nat.div_add_mod n p).symm⟩
    cases k with
    | zero =>
      unfold blockCount
      rw [Nat.zero_div, Nat.zero_mod, layer_zero_right, layer_zero_right, layer_zero_right]
      exact MEq.refl _ _
    | succ k =>
      obtain ⟨c, d, hd, hk⟩ : ∃ c d, d < p ∧ k = p * c + d :=
        ⟨k / p, k % p, Nat.mod_lt k hp0, (Nat.div_add_mod k p).symm⟩
      have IH := MEq.add (ih k) (ih (k + 1))
      rw [layer_succ_succ]
      push_cast
      refine MEq.trans IH ?_
       
      rw [hn, hk]
      by_cases hb1 : b + 1 < p <;> by_cases hd1 : d + 1 < p
      ·  
        rw [show p * a + b + 1 = p * a + (b + 1) by omega, show p * c + d + 1 = p * c + (d + 1) by omega,
          blockCount_eq hb hd, blockCount_eq hb hd1, blockCount_eq hb1 hd1, layer_succ_succ]
        push_cast; rw [Int.mul_add]; exact MEq.refl _ _
      ·  
        have hdp : d + 1 = p := by omega
        rw [show p * a + b + 1 = p * a + (b + 1) by omega, show p * c + d + 1 = p * (c + 1) + 0 by grind,
          blockCount_eq hb hd, blockCount_eq hb hp0, blockCount_eq hb1 hp0,
          layer_eq_zero b d (by omega), layer_zero_right, layer_zero_right]
        simp; exact MEq.refl _ _
      ·  
        have hbp : b + 1 = p := by omega
        rw [show p * a + b + 1 = p * (a + 1) + 0 by grind, show p * c + d + 1 = p * c + (d + 1) by omega,
          blockCount_eq hb hd, blockCount_eq hb hd1, blockCount_eq hp0 hd1,
          layer_zero_left]
        simp only [show d + 1 ≠ 0 by omega, ↓reduceIte]
        have hmid : p ∣ layer b d + layer b (d + 1) := by
          rw [← layer_succ_succ, hbp]; exact prime_dvd_middle hp (by omega) hd1
        obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hmid
        refine ⟨layer a c * t, ?_⟩
        have : ((layer b d : Nat) : Int) + (layer b (d + 1) : Nat) = (p : Int) * t := by
          rw [← Int.natCast_add, ht]; simp
        simp only [Int.natCast_mul, Nat.mul_zero, Int.natCast_zero, Int.sub_zero]
        rw [← Int.mul_add, this]; grind
      ·  
        have hbp : b + 1 = p := by omega
        have hdp : d + 1 = p := by omega
        rw [show p * a + b + 1 = p * (a + 1) + 0 by grind, show p * c + d + 1 = p * (c + 1) + 0 by grind,
          blockCount_eq hb hd, blockCount_eq hb hp0, blockCount_eq hp0 hp0,
          show d = b by omega, layer_self, layer_zero_right, layer_zero_right, layer_succ_succ]
        simp; exact MEq.refl _ _

name: MultAdd.Cube.lucas
doc: **Lucas's theorem.** For n, k with at most f base-p digits, C(n,k) ≡ product over digits of C(nᵢ, kᵢ) (mod p).
statement: ∀ f n k, n < p ^ f → k < p ^ f → MEq p (layer n k) (digitProd p f n k)
proof:
by
  intro f
  induction f with
  | zero =>
    intro n k hn hk
    have h1 : n = 0 := by simp at hn; omega
    have h2 : k = 0 := by simp at hk; omega
    subst h1; subst h2; exact MEq.refl _ _
  | succ f ih =>
    intro n k hn hk
    rw [Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_comm] at hn hk
    have h2 := ih (n / p) (k / p) (Nat.div_lt_of_lt_mul hn) (Nat.div_lt_of_lt_mul hk)
    refine MEq.trans (lucas_step hp n k) ?_
    unfold blockCount
    simp only [digitProd, Int.natCast_mul]
    rw [Int.mul_comm (layer (n / p) (k / p) : Int)]
    exact MEq.mul (MEq.refl _ _) h2

name: MultAdd.Cube.exists_prime_factor
statement: ∀ n, 2 ≤ n → ∃ p, IsPrime p ∧ p ∣ n
proof:
by
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strongRecOn with
  | _ n ih =>
    intro hn
    rcases Classical.em (IsPrime n) with hpn | hpn
    · exact ⟨n, hpn, Nat.dvd_refl n⟩
    · have hex : ∃ d, d ∣ n ∧ d ≠ 1 ∧ d ≠ n := by
        apply Classical.byContradiction
        intro h
        apply hpn
        refine ⟨hn, fun d hd => ?_⟩
        apply Classical.byContradiction
        intro h'
        exact h ⟨d, hd, by omega, by omega⟩
      obtain ⟨d, hd, hd1, hdn⟩ := hex
      have hd0 : d ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0; subst h0; have := Nat.eq_zero_of_zero_dvd hd; omega
      have hdlt : d < n := by have := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hd; omega
      obtain ⟨p, hp, hpd⟩ := ih d hdlt (by omega)
      exact ⟨p, hp, Nat.dvd_trans hpd hd⟩

name: MultAdd.Cube.aks_middle
doc: **The AKS identity on the cube.** For n ≥ 2: every middle layer of the n-cube has a multiple of n corners exactly when n is prime. (Equivalently (1 + x)ⁿ ≡ 1 + xⁿ mod n: the mult-add n-th power equals the plain n-th power, which is the identity behind the AKS test.)
statement: (∀ k, 0 < k → k < n → n ∣ layer n k) ↔ IsPrime n
proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro hall
    apply Classical.byContradiction
    intro hnp
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hpn⟩ := exists_prime_factor n hn
    have hpne : p ≠ n := fun h => hnp (h ▸ hp)
    have hp2 := hp.1
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hpn
    obtain ⟨m', rfl⟩ : ∃ m', m = m' + 1 := ⟨m - 1, by
      cases m with
      | zero => simp at hm; omega
      | succ m => omega⟩
    have hm' : n = p * m' + p := by rw [hm, Nat.mul_succ]
    have hm1 : 1 ≤ m' := by
      cases m' with
      | zero => simp at hm'; omega
      | succ _ => omega
    have hpm : p ≤ p * m' := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right p hm1
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hall p (by omega) (by omega)
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ : ∃ q, n = q + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j, p = j + 1 := ⟨p - 1, by omega⟩
    have hab := absorb q j
    rw [← hq, ← hj, ht] at hab
    have hcancel : layer q j = p * t := by
      apply Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (show 0 < n by omega)
      rw [← hab]; grind
    have hjp : j < p := by omega
    have hqform : q = p * m' + j := by omega
    have hl := lucas_step hp q j
    have hb : blockCount p q j = 1 := by
      unfold blockCount
      rw [hqform, (divmod_of_eq (q := m') hjp).1, (divmod_of_eq (q := m') hjp).2,
        Nat.div_eq_of_lt hjp, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hjp, layer_zero_right, layer_self]
    rw [hb, hcancel] at hl
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hl
    have h1 : (p : Int) ∣ 1 := ⟨t - c, by push_cast at hc; grind⟩
    have := Int.le_of_dvd (by decide) h1
    omega
  · intro hp k hk0 hkn
    exact prime_dvd_middle hp hk0 hkn

name: MultAdd.Cube.bsum_add
statement: ∀ m, bsum (fun k => f k + g k) m = bsum f m + bsum g m
proof:
| 0 => by simp [bsum]
  | m + 1 => by simp only [bsum]; rw [bsum_add f g m]; grind

name: MultAdd.Cube.bsum_mul
statement: ∀ m, bsum (fun k => c * f k) m = c * bsum f m
proof:
| 0 => by simp [bsum]
  | m + 1 => by simp only [bsum]; rw [bsum_mul c f m]; grind

name: MultAdd.Cube.bsum_shift
statement: ∀ m, bsum f (m + 1) = f 0 + bsum (fun k => f (k + 1)) m
proof:
| 0 => by simp [bsum]
  | m + 1 => by
    rw [bsum, bsum_shift f m]; simp only [bsum]; grind

name: MultAdd.Cube.bsum_congr
statement: ∀ m, (∀ k, k < m → f k = g k) → bsum f m = bsum g m
proof:
| 0, _ => rfl
  | m + 1, h => by
    simp only [bsum]; rw [bsum_congr f g m (fun k hk => h k (by omega)), h m (by omega)]

name: MultAdd.Cube.bsum_dvd
statement: ∀ m, (∀ k, k < m → d ∣ f k) → d ∣ bsum f m
proof:
| 0, _ => ⟨0, by simp [bsum]⟩
  | m + 1, h => by
    simp only [bsum]
    exact Int.dvd_add (bsum_dvd d f m (fun k hk => h k (by omega))) (h m (by omega))

name: MultAdd.Cube.binomial
doc: **The cube's corner count.** (1 + x)ⁿ = Σₖ C(n,k) xᵏ: a box of side 1 + x cut at 1 on every axis falls into the n-cube's corner pieces.
statement: ∀ n x, (1 + x) ^ n = cubeSum n x
proof:
by
  intro n x
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [cubeSum, bsum, layer]
  | succ n ih =>
    have hT : bsum (fun k => (layer n (k + 1) : Int) * x ^ (k + 1)) (n + 1) = cubeSum n x - 1 := by
      have hc : cubeSum n x = 1 + bsum (fun k => (layer n (k + 1) : Int) * x ^ (k + 1)) n := by
        unfold cubeSum; rw [bsum_shift]; simp [layer_zero_right]
      rw [hc, bsum, layer_eq_zero n (n + 1) (by omega)]; simp; omega
    have step : cubeSum (n + 1) x = x * cubeSum n x + cubeSum n x := by
      unfold cubeSum
      rw [bsum_shift]
      have e : (fun k => ((layer (n + 1) (k + 1) : Nat) : Int) * x ^ (k + 1)) =
          (fun k => x * ((layer n k : Int) * x ^ k) + (layer n (k + 1) : Int) * x ^ (k + 1)) := by
        funext k; rw [layer_succ_succ, Int.natCast_add, Int.pow_succ]; grind
      rw [e, bsum_add, bsum_mul]
      have hT' := hT; unfold cubeSum at hT'
      rw [hT']; simp [layer_zero_right]; grind
    rw [Int.pow_succ, ih, step]; grind

name: MultAdd.Cube.frobenius
doc: **Mult-add powers are plain powers mod p.** (1 + x)ᵖ ≡ 1 + xᵖ: in the p-cube only the two end corners survive mod p.
statement: MEq p ((1 + x) ^ p) (1 + x ^ p)
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ : ∃ q, p = q + 1 := ⟨p - 1, by have := hp.1; omega⟩
  rw [binomial]
  unfold cubeSum
  rw [hq, bsum, bsum_shift]
  have hmid : (p : Int) ∣ bsum (fun k => ((layer (q + 1) (k + 1) : Nat) : Int) * x ^ (k + 1)) q := by
    apply bsum_dvd
    intro k hk
    have := prime_dvd_middle hp (k := k + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    rw [hq] at this
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := this
    exact ⟨c * x ^ (k + 1), by rw [hc, hq]; push_cast; grind⟩
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hmid
  refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
  rw [layer_self, layer_zero_right, ← hq]
  simp only [Int.natCast_one, Int.pow_zero, Int.one_mul, Int.mul_one]
  rw [hq] at hc ⊢
  push_cast at hc ⊢
  omega

name: MultAdd.Cube.fermat
doc: **Fermat's little theorem.** aᵖ ≡ a (mod p) for every natural number a. Each step a → a + 1 adds one mult-add unit, and frobenius says the p-th power passes straight through it mod p.
statement: ∀ a : Nat, MEq p ((a : Int) ^ p) a
proof:
by
  have hp1 : 1 ≤ p := by have := hp.1; omega
  intro a
  induction a with
  | zero =>
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ : ∃ q, p = q + 1 := ⟨p - 1, by omega⟩
    rw [hq]; simp [Int.pow_succ]; exact MEq.refl _ _
  | succ a ih =>
    have h := frobenius hp (a : Int)
    have e : ((a + 1 : Nat) : Int) = 1 + (a : Int) := by push_cast; grind
    rw [e]
    exact MEq.trans h (MEq.add (MEq.refl _ 1) ih)

name: MultAdd.HopfOne.oneMod_oddPow
doc: Raising to an odd power keeps the level (for j ≥ 1).
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := hA
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ : ∃ i, j = i + 1 := ⟨j - 1, by omega⟩
  intro t
  induction t with
  | zero => exact ⟨u, by simp⟩
  | succ t ih =>
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := ih
    refine ⟨(2 * (2 ^ i * (2 * u + 1)) * (2 ^ i * (2 * u + 1)) + 2 * (2 ^ i * (2 * u + 1))) * (2 * v + 1)
        + v + 2 ^ i * (2 * u + 1) * (2 * u + 1) + (2 * u + 1), ?_⟩
    have e : 2 * (t + 1) + 1 = (2 * t + 1) + 2 := by omega
    rw [e, Nat.pow_add, hv, Nat.pow_succ 2 i]
    grind

name: MultAdd.HopfOne.oneMod_sq
doc: Squaring raises the level by one (for j ≥ 2).
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := hA
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ : ∃ i, j = i + 2 := ⟨j - 2, by omega⟩
  refine ⟨u + 2 ^ i * (2 * u + 1) * (2 * u + 1), ?_⟩
  rw [show i + 2 + 1 = i + 3 by omega, Nat.pow_add 2 i 3, Nat.pow_add 2 i 2]
  grind

name: MultAdd.HopfOne.three_pow_two_pow
doc: 3^(2^k) is one more than 2^(k+2) times an odd number, for k ≥ 1.
proof:
by
  intro k hk
  induction k with
  | zero => omega
  | succ k ih =>
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with rfl | hpos
    · exact ⟨0, by decide⟩
    · have h := oneMod_sq (by omega) (ih hpos)
      rw [show 2 ^ (k + 1) = 2 ^ k * 2 from Nat.pow_succ 2 k, Nat.pow_mul]
      exact h

name: MultAdd.HopfOne.two_adic_split
doc: Every positive n is 2^k times an odd number.
proof:
by
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strongRecOn with
  | _ n ih =>
    intro hn
    rcases Nat.mod_two_eq_zero_or_one n with h0 | h1
    · obtain ⟨k, t, ht⟩ := ih (n / 2) (by omega) (by omega)
      have hm : n = 2 * (n / 2) := by omega
      exact ⟨k + 1, t, by rw [hm, ht, Nat.pow_succ]; grind⟩
    · exact ⟨0, n / 2, by simp; omega⟩

name: MultAdd.HopfOne.level_three_pow
doc: The level of 3^n: 1 if n is odd, k + 2 if n = 2^k · odd with k ≥ 1.
statement: OneMod (if k = 0 then 1 else k + 2) (3 ^ (2 ^ k * (2 * t + 1)))
proof:
by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with rfl | hk
  · simpa using oneMod_oddPow (j := 1) (A := 3) (Nat.le_refl 1) ⟨0, rfl⟩ t
  · have hk0 : k ≠ 0 := by omega
    simp only [hk0, ↓reduceIte]
    rw [Nat.pow_mul]
    exact oneMod_oddPow (by omega) (three_pow_two_pow k hk) t

name: MultAdd.HopfOne.le_of_dvd_two_pow_odd
doc: If 2^n divides 2^e times an odd number, then n ≤ e.
proof:
by
  apply Nat.le_of_not_lt
  intro hlt
  have h1 : 2 ^ (e + 1) ∣ 2 ^ e * (2 * u + 1) :=
    Nat.dvd_trans (Nat.pow_dvd_pow 2 hlt) h
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := h1
  rw [Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_assoc] at hc
  have := Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (Nat.pow_pos (by decide : 0 < 2)) hc
  omega

name: MultAdd.HopfOne.pow_ge
doc: 2^k ≥ k + 3 once k ≥ 3.
proof:
by
  induction k with
  | zero => omega
  | succ k ih =>
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge k 3 with h | h
    · have : k = 2 := by omega
      subst this; decide
    · have := ih h; rw [Nat.pow_succ]; omega

name: MultAdd.HopfOne.only_one_two_four
doc: **Part 1.** 2^n | 3^n − 1 forces n = 1, 2 or 4 (for n ≥ 1).
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨k, t, hkt⟩ := two_adic_split n hn
  have hlev := level_three_pow k t
  rw [← hkt] at hlev
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hlev
  have hle : n ≤ (if k = 0 then 1 else k + 2) := by
    apply le_of_dvd_two_pow_odd (u := u)
    rw [hu, Nat.add_sub_cancel] at h
    exact h
  have hbig : 2 ^ k ≤ n := by
    rw [hkt]; exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (by omega)
  have hn4 : n ≤ 4 := by
    by_cases hk : k = 0
    · simp only [hk, ↓reduceIte] at hle; omega
    · simp only [hk, ↓reduceIte] at hle
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge k 3 with h3 | h3
      · omega
      · have := pow_ge k h3; omega
  have : n = 1 ∨ n = 2 ∨ n = 3 ∨ n = 4 := by omega
  rcases this with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
  · exact Or.inl rfl
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)
  · exact absurd h (by decide)
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inr rfl)

name: MultAdd.HopfOne.one_two_four_work
doc: And the three survivors really work.
proof: by decide

name: MultAdd.HopfOne.commute_equation
doc: ψ² ψ³ = ψ³ ψ² on a gives Adams and Atiyah's equation.
proof:
by
  have hβ := congrArg Elt.β hc
  simp only [psi] at hβ
  grind

name: MultAdd.HopfOne.odd_mul
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hx; obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := hy
  exact ⟨2 * a * b + a + b, by grind⟩

name: MultAdd.HopfOne.odd_three_pow
proof:
by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, by decide⟩
  | succ n ih => rw [Int.pow_succ]; exact odd_mul ih ⟨1, by decide⟩

name: MultAdd.HopfOne.two_pow_dvd_of_mul_odd
doc: Euclid's step for powers of 2: an odd factor can be cancelled.
statement: ∀ (n : Nat) (x y : Int), IsOdd y → (2 : Int) ^ n ∣ x * y → (2 : Int) ^ n ∣ x
proof:
by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro x y _ _; exact ⟨x, by simp⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    intro x y hy h
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := hy
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := h
    have hx2 : x % 2 = 0 := by
      rcases Int.emod_two_eq x with hx | hx
      · exact hx
      · exfalso
        have hx' : x = 2 * (x / 2) + 1 := by omega
        rw [Int.pow_succ] at hc
        have : 2 * (2 * (x / 2) * m + x / 2 + m) + 1 = 2 * (2 ^ n * c) := by
          rw [hx'] at hc; grind
        omega
    have hx' : x = 2 * (x / 2) := by omega
    have : (2 : Int) ^ n ∣ (x / 2) * (2 * m + 1) := by
      refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
      rw [Int.pow_succ] at hc
      have h2 : 2 * ((x / 2) * (2 * m + 1)) = 2 * (2 ^ n * c) := by
        rw [hx'] at hc; grind
      omega
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := ih (x / 2) (2 * m + 1) ⟨m, rfl⟩ this
    exact ⟨d, by rw [hx', hd, Int.pow_succ]; grind⟩

name: MultAdd.HopfOne.hopf_invariant_one
doc: **Part 2.** Commuting Adams operations, the mod-2 rule and an odd Hopf invariant h force n = 1, 2 or 4.
proof:
by
  have heq := commute_equation n μ₂ μ₃ hc
  have hμ : IsOdd μ₂ := by
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := hodd; obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hmod
    exact ⟨c + m, by omega⟩
  have hdvd : (2 : Int) ^ n ∣ ((3 : Int) ^ n - 1) * (3 ^ n * μ₂) :=
    ⟨(2 ^ n - 1) * μ₃, by rw [← Int.mul_assoc, Int.mul_comm (3 ^ n - 1) (3 ^ n), ← heq]; grind⟩
  have hI : (2 : Int) ^ n ∣ (3 : Int) ^ n - 1 :=
    two_pow_dvd_of_mul_odd n _ _ (odd_mul (odd_three_pow n) hμ) hdvd
  have h1 : 1 ≤ 3 ^ n := Nat.pow_pos (by decide)
  have hN : 2 ^ n ∣ 3 ^ n - 1 := by
    have hcast : ((3 ^ n - 1 : Nat) : Int) = (3 : Int) ^ n - 1 := by
      rw [Int.ofNat_sub h1]; simp
    rw [← hcast, show (2 : Int) ^ n = ((2 ^ n : Nat) : Int) by simp] at hI
    exact Int.ofNat_dvd.mp hI
  exact only_one_two_four n hn hN

name: MultAdd.HopfOne.mpow_formula
doc: (1 + x)^k − 1 = k x + C(k,2) x², written without division.
proof:
by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [mpow]
  | succ k ih =>
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := ih
    simp only [mpow, madd]
    constructor
    · rw [h1]; simp
    · simp only [Int.add_zero, Int.mul_one]
      rw [h1, Int.mul_add, h2]; simp only [Int.natCast_add, Int.natCast_one]; grind

name: MultAdd.HopfOne.psi_compose
doc: Mult-add powers compose: ψ^j ψ^k = ψ^(jk), for every j, k.
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨a1, b1⟩ := mpow_formula j
  obtain ⟨a2, b2⟩ := mpow_formula k
  obtain ⟨a3, b3⟩ := mpow_formula (j * k)
  have : 2 * (psiT j (mpow k)).β = 2 * (mpow (j * k)).β := by
    simp only [psiT]
    rw [Int.mul_add, a1, a2, b3]
    have e1 : 2 * ((k : Int) * (mpow j).β) = k * (2 * (mpow j).β) := by grind
    have e2 : 2 * ((mpow k).β * ((j : Int) * j)) = (2 * (mpow k).β) * (j * j) := by grind
    rw [e1, e2, b1, b2]; push_cast; grind
  cases hp : psiT j (mpow k) with
  | mk p q =>
    cases hm : mpow (j * k) with
    | mk r s =>
      rw [hp, hm] at this
      simp only [psiT] at hp
      have hα : p = r := by
        have := congrArg Trunc.α hp; have := congrArg Trunc.α hm
        simp_all; push_cast; grind
      simp at this; subst hα; simp; omega

name: MultAdd.HopfOne.cp2_case
doc: CP² meets every hypothesis of Part 2 with n = 1, h = 1: μ₂ = C(2,2) = 1, μ₃ = C(3,2) = 3, and ψ² ψ³ = ψ³ ψ².
proof:
by
  refine ⟨by decide, by decide, by simp [psi], ⟨0, by decide⟩⟩

name: MultAdd.Cube.dsum_eq
statement: dsum p x = x % p + dsum p (x / p)
proof:
by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos x with rfl | hx
  · rw [dsum]; simp [dsum]
  · rw [dsum]; simp [hp, hx]

name: MultAdd.Cube.dsum_zero
proof: by rw [dsum]; simp

name: MultAdd.Cube.val_of_mod_ne
proof:
by
  rw [val]; simp [h]

name: MultAdd.Cube.val_of_mod_eq
statement: val p x = 1 + val p (x / p)
proof:
by
  rw [val]; simp [hp, hx, h]

name: MultAdd.Cube.carries_eq
statement: carries p a b c = (a % p + b % p + c) / p + carries p (a / p) (b / p) ((a % p + b % p + c) / p)
proof:
by
  rw [carries]; simp [hp, hab]

name: MultAdd.Cube.carries_zero
proof:
by
  rw [carries]; simp

name: MultAdd.Cube.carries_dsum
doc: Adding digit by digit: each carry turns p units of digit sum into 1.
statement: ∀ s a b c, a + b = s → c ≤ 1 → (p - 1) * carries p a b c + dsum p (a + b + c) = dsum p a + dsum p b + c
proof:
by
  intro s
  induction s using Nat.strongRecOn with
  | _ s ih =>
  intro a b c hs hc
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (a + b) with h0 | hpos
  · have ha : a = 0 := by omega
    have hb : b = 0 := by omega
    subst ha; subst hb
    simp only [Nat.zero_add]
    rw [carries_zero, dsum_eq hp c, dsum_zero]
    have hc' : c % p = c := Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)
    have hc'' : c / p = 0 := Nat.div_eq_of_lt (by omega)
    rw [hc', hc'', dsum_zero]; omega
  · rw [carries_eq hp a b c hpos]
    have ra := Nat.mod_add_div a p
    have rb := Nat.mod_add_div b p
    have ma := Nat.mod_lt a (by omega : p > 0)
    have mb := Nat.mod_lt b (by omega : p > 0)
    generalize hr : a % p + b % p + c = r
    have rr := Nat.mod_add_div r p
    have mr := Nat.mod_lt r (by omega : p > 0)
    have hc1 : r / p ≤ 1 := by
      have : r < p * 2 := by omega
      exact Nat.le_of_lt_succ ((Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul (by omega)).2 (by grind))
    have hsum : a + b + c = p * (a / p + b / p + r / p) + r % p := by
      rw [Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_add]; omega
    have dm := divmod_of_eq (q := a / p + b / p + r / p) mr
    rw [← hsum] at dm
    have hlt : a / p + b / p < s := by
      have h1 := Nat.div_le_self a p
      have h2 := Nat.div_le_self b p
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos a with ha | ha
      · have := Nat.div_lt_self (n := b) (by omega) (by omega : 1 < p); omega
      · have := Nat.div_lt_self ha (by omega : 1 < p); omega
    have IH := ih _ hlt (a / p) (b / p) (r / p) rfl hc1
    rw [dsum_eq hp (a + b + c), dm.1, dm.2, dsum_eq hp a, dsum_eq hp b]
    have e1 : (p - 1) * (r / p + carries p (a / p) (b / p) (r / p)) =
        (p - 1) * (r / p) + (p - 1) * carries p (a / p) (b / p) (r / p) := Nat.mul_add _ _ _
    have e2 : (p - 1) * (r / p) + r / p = p * (r / p) := by
      rw [Nat.sub_one_mul]; have : r / p ≤ p * (r / p) := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ (by omega); omega
    omega

name: MultAdd.Cube.dsum_succ
doc: Adding 1: the digit sum goes up by 1, minus p−1 for each trailing digit p−1.
statement: ∀ x, dsum p (x + 1) + (p - 1) * val p (x + 1) = dsum p x + 1
proof:
by
  intro x
  induction x using Nat.strongRecOn with
  | _ x ih =>
  have rx := Nat.mod_add_div x p
  have mx := Nat.mod_lt x (by omega : p > 0)
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (x % p + 1) p with h | h
  · have e : x + 1 = p * (x / p) + (x % p + 1) := by omega
    have dm := divmod_of_eq (q := x / p) h
    rw [← e] at dm
    rw [val_of_mod_ne (by omega), dsum_eq hp (x + 1), dm.1, dm.2, dsum_eq hp x]
    omega
  · have e : x + 1 = p * (x / p + 1) + 0 := by rw [Nat.mul_add]; omega
    have dm := divmod_of_eq (q := x / p + 1) (by omega : 0 < p)
    rw [← e] at dm
    have hx : 0 < x := by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos x with h0 | h0
      · subst h0; simp at h; omega
      · exact h0
    have IH := ih (x / p) (Nat.div_lt_self hx (by omega))
    rw [val_of_mod_eq hp (by omega) dm.2, dm.1, dsum_eq hp (x + 1), dm.1, dm.2, dsum_eq hp x]
    have e1 : (p - 1) * (1 + val p (x / p + 1)) = (p - 1) + (p - 1) * val p (x / p + 1) := by
      rw [Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_one]
    omega

name: MultAdd.Cube.val_spec
statement: ∀ x, 0 < x → Val p x (val p x)
proof:
by
  intro x
  induction x using Nat.strongRecOn with
  | _ x ih =>
  intro hx
  by_cases h : x % p = 0
  · rw [val_of_mod_eq hp hx h]
    have rx := Nat.mod_add_div x p
    have hq : 0 < x / p := by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (x / p) with h0 | h0
      · rw [h0] at rx; omega
      · exact h0
    have IH := ih (x / p) (Nat.div_lt_self hx (by omega)) hq
    have ex : x = p * (x / p) := by omega
    have pp : 0 < p := by omega
    generalize x / p = q at IH ex ⊢
    subst ex
    constructor
    · rw [ Nat.add_comm, Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_comm (p ^ _) p]
      exact Nat.mul_dvd_mul_left p IH.1
    · rw [Nat.add_comm 1, Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_comm (p ^ _) p, Nat.mul_dvd_mul_iff_left pp]
      exact IH.2
  · rw [val_of_mod_ne h]
    refine ⟨by simp, ?_⟩
    simp only [Nat.zero_add, Nat.pow_one]
    intro hd; exact h (Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd hd)

name: MultAdd.Cube.Val.unique
proof:
by
  rcases Nat.lt_trichotomy e f with h | h | h
  · exact absurd (Nat.dvd_trans (Nat.pow_dvd_pow p (by omega)) hf.1) he.2
  · exact h
  · exact absurd (Nat.dvd_trans (Nat.pow_dvd_pow p (by omega)) he.1) hf.2

name: MultAdd.Cube.euclid
proof:
by
  have hc : Nat.Coprime p a := by
    rcases hp.2 _ (Nat.gcd_dvd_left p a) with g | g
    · exact g
    · exact absurd (g ▸ Nat.gcd_dvd_right p a) ha
  exact hc.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left h

name: MultAdd.Cube.Val.mul
proof:
by
  have pp : 0 < p := by have := hp.1; omega
  obtain ⟨a', rfl⟩ := ha.1
  obtain ⟨b', rfl⟩ := hb.1
  have na : ¬ p ∣ a' := by
    intro hd; apply ha.2; rw [Nat.pow_succ]; exact Nat.mul_dvd_mul_left _ hd
  have nb : ¬ p ∣ b' := by
    intro hd; apply hb.2; rw [Nat.pow_succ]; exact Nat.mul_dvd_mul_left _ hd
  have e1 : p ^ e * a' * (p ^ f * b') = p ^ (e + f) * (a' * b') := by
    rw [Nat.pow_add]; grind
  rw [e1]
  refine ⟨Nat.dvd_mul_right _ _, ?_⟩
  rw [Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_dvd_mul_iff_left (Nat.pow_pos pp)]
  intro hd
  exact nb (euclid hp na hd)

name: MultAdd.Cube.layer_pos
statement: ∀ n k, k ≤ n → 0 < layer n k
proof:
| n, 0, _ => by rw [layer_zero_right]; decide
  | 0, _ + 1, h => absurd h (by omega)
  | n + 1, k + 1, h => by
    rw [layer_succ_succ]; have := layer_pos n k (by omega); omega

name: MultAdd.Cube.layer_val_dsum
doc: The cube count and the digit sums: (p−1)·v_p(C(j+k,k)) = s(j) + s(k) − s(j+k).
statement: ∀ k j, (p - 1) * val p (layer (j + k) k) + dsum p (j + k) = dsum p j + dsum p k
proof:
by
  have p2 := hp.1
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro j
    rw [Nat.add_zero, layer_zero_right, val_of_mod_ne (by rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)]; decide),
      dsum_zero]
    simp
  | succ k ih =>
    intro j
    have IH := ih j
    have ab := absorb (j + k) k
    have L := val_spec p2 (layer (j + k + 1) (k + 1)) (layer_pos _ _ (by omega))
    have R := val_spec p2 (layer (j + k) k) (layer_pos _ _ (by omega))
    have v1 := val_spec p2 (j + k + 1) (by omega)
    have v2 := val_spec p2 (k + 1) (by omega)
    have hL := Val.mul hp v2 L
    have hR := Val.mul hp v1 R
    rw [ab] at hL
    have hu := Val.unique hL hR
    have hu' := congrArg (fun t => (p - 1) * t) hu
    simp only [Nat.mul_add] at hu'
    have s1 := dsum_succ p2 (j + k)
    have s2 := dsum_succ p2 k
    show (p - 1) * val p (layer (j + k + 1) (k + 1)) + dsum p (j + k + 1) = dsum p j + dsum p (k + 1)
    omega

name: MultAdd.Cube.kummer
doc: **Kummer's theorem (1852).** The exact power of p that divides C(j+k, k), the number of corners of the (j+k)-cube with k switches on, is the number of carries when you add j and k in base p.
statement: p ^ carries p j k 0 ∣ layer (j + k) k ∧ ¬ p ^ (carries p j k 0 + 1) ∣ layer (j + k) k
proof:
by
  have p2 := hp.1
  have h1 := layer_val_dsum hp k j
  have h2 := carries_dsum p2 (j + k) j k 0 rfl (by omega)
  rw [Nat.add_zero] at h2
  have e : (p - 1) * val p (layer (j + k) k) = (p - 1) * carries p j k 0 := by omega
  have e' := Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (by omega) e
  have := val_spec p2 (layer (j + k) k) (layer_pos _ _ (by omega))
  rw [e'] at this
  exact this

name: MultAdd.Cube.S_add
statement: S n (fun k => f k + g k) = S n f + S n g
proof:
by
  unfold S; rw [← bsum_add]; congr 1; funext k; grind

name: MultAdd.Cube.S_mul
statement: S n (fun k => c * f k) = c * S n f
proof:
by
  unfold S; rw [← bsum_mul]; congr 1; funext k; grind

name: MultAdd.Cube.S_zero
proof:
by
  have := S_mul n 0 (fun _ => 0); simp at this ⊢; exact this

name: MultAdd.Cube.S_sub
statement: S n (fun k => f k - g k) = S n f - S n g
proof:
by
  have h1 := S_add n f (fun k => (-1) * g k)
  rw [S_mul] at h1
  have e : (fun k => f k - g k) = (fun k => f k + (-1) * g k) := by funext k; grind
  rw [e, h1]; grind

name: MultAdd.Cube.S_bsum
statement: ∀ m, S n (fun k => bsum (fun i => g i k) m) = bsum (fun i => S n (g i)) m
proof:
| 0 => by simp only [bsum]; exact S_zero n
  | m + 1 => by simp only [bsum]; rw [S_add, S_bsum n g m]

name: MultAdd.Cube.S_succ
doc: Pascal's rule for the signed sum: adding an axis takes a difference.
statement: S (n + 1) f = S n f - S n (fun k => f (k + 1))
proof:
by
  unfold S
  rw [bsum_shift]
  have e : (fun k => (-1 : Int) ^ (k + 1) * ((layer (n + 1) (k + 1) : Nat) : Int) * f (k + 1)) =
      (fun k => (-1 : Int) ^ (k + 1) * (layer n (k + 1) : Int) * f (k + 1) +
        (-1) * ((-1 : Int) ^ k * (layer n k : Int) * f (k + 1))) := by
    funext k; rw [layer_succ_succ, Int.natCast_add, Int.pow_succ]; grind
  rw [e, bsum_add, bsum_mul]
  have h2 : bsum (fun k => (-1 : Int) ^ k * (layer n k : Int) * f k) (n + 1) =
      (-1 : Int) ^ 0 * (layer n 0 : Int) * f 0 +
        bsum (fun k => (-1 : Int) ^ (k + 1) * (layer n (k + 1) : Int) * f (k + 1)) (n + 1) := by
    rw [bsum_shift, bsum, layer_eq_zero n (n + 1) (by omega)]; simp
  rw [h2]; simp only [layer_zero_right]; omega

name: MultAdd.Cube.layer_succ_self
proof:
by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => rw [layer_succ_succ, ih, layer_self]

name: MultAdd.Cube.S_pow
doc: **Inclusion–exclusion on the cube.** Σₖ (−1)ᵏ C(n,k) (c − k)ᵐ is n! when m = n and 0 when m < n. With c = n it counts the orderings of n things: corner K of the n-cube is the set of values a map is made to miss, and the signed count of maps that miss them leaves exactly the maps that miss nothing.
statement: ∀ n m, m ≤ n → ∀ c : Int, S n (fun k => (c - k) ^ m) = if m = n then (fact n : Int) else 0
proof:
by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro m hm c
    have : m = 0 := by omega
    subst this; simp [S, bsum, layer, fact]
  | succ n ih =>
    intro m hm c
    rw [S_succ]
    have hd : ∀ k : Nat, (c - (k : Int)) ^ m - (c - ((k + 1 : Nat) : Int)) ^ m =
        bsum (fun i => (layer m i : Int) * ((c - 1) - k) ^ i) m := by
      intro k
      have hb := binomial m ((c - 1) - k)
      unfold cubeSum at hb
      rw [bsum, layer_self] at hb
      have e1 : 1 + ((c - 1) - k) = c - (k : Int) := by grind
      have e2 : c - ((k + 1 : Nat) : Int) = (c - 1) - k := by push_cast; grind
      rw [e1] at hb; rw [e2, hb]; simp
    have e3 : S n (fun k => (c - k) ^ m) - S n (fun k => (c - ((k + 1 : Nat) : Int)) ^ m) =
        S n (fun k => bsum (fun i => (layer m i : Int) * ((c - 1) - k) ^ i) m) := by
      rw [← S_sub]; congr 1; funext k; exact hd k
    rw [e3]
    have e4 := S_bsum n (fun i (k : Nat) => (layer m i : Int) * ((c - 1) - (k : Int)) ^ i) m
    rw [e4]
    have e5 : ∀ i, i < m → S n (fun k => (layer m i : Int) * ((c - 1) - (k : Int)) ^ i) =
        (layer m i : Int) * (if i = n then (fact n : Int) else 0) := by
      intro i hi
      rw [S_mul, ih i (by omega) (c - 1)]
    rw [bsum_congr _ _ m e5]
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge m (n + 1) with hlt | hge
    · have : ∀ i, i < m → (layer m i : Int) * (if i = n then (fact n : Int) else 0) = 0 := by
        intro i hi; have : i ≠ n := by omega
        simp [this]
      rw [bsum_congr _ (fun _ => 0) m this]
      have hz : ∀ m, bsum (fun _ => (0 : Int)) m = 0 := by
        intro m; induction m with
        | zero => rfl
        | succ m ih => simp [bsum, ih]
      rw [hz]; have : m ≠ n + 1 := by omega
      simp [this]
    · have hm' : m = n + 1 := by omega
      subst hm'
      rw [bsum]
      have : ∀ i, i < n → (layer (n + 1) i : Int) * (if i = n then (fact n : Int) else 0) = 0 := by
        intro i hi; have : i ≠ n := by omega
        simp [this]
      rw [bsum_congr _ (fun _ => 0) n this]
      have hz : ∀ m, bsum (fun _ => (0 : Int)) m = 0 := by
        intro m; induction m with
        | zero => rfl
        | succ m ih => simp [bsum, ih]
      rw [hz, layer_succ_self]
      simp [fact]

name: MultAdd.Cube.bsum_meq
statement: ∀ m, (∀ k, k < m → MEq p (f k) (g k)) → MEq p (bsum f m) (bsum g m)
proof:
| 0, _ => MEq.refl _ _
  | m + 1, h => by
    simp only [bsum]
    exact MEq.add (bsum_meq f g m (fun k hk => h k (by omega))) (h m (by omega))

name: MultAdd.Cube.bsum_one
proof:
| 0 => rfl
  | m + 1 => by simp only [bsum]; rw [bsum_one m]; push_cast; rfl

name: MultAdd.Cube.alt_layer
doc: Along the (p−1)-cube, the layer counts alternate ±1 mod p.
statement: ∀ k, k ≤ p - 1 → MEq p ((-1 : Int) ^ k * (layer (p - 1) k : Int)) 1
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ : ∃ q, p = q + 1 := ⟨p - 1, by have := hp.1; omega⟩
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => intro _; simp [layer_zero_right]; exact MEq.refl _ _
  | succ k ih =>
    intro hk
    have IH := ih (by omega)
    have hd := prime_dvd_middle hp (k := k + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    rw [hq, layer_succ_succ] at hd
    rw [hq, Nat.add_sub_cancel] at IH ⊢
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hd
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := IH
    refine ⟨(-1 : Int) ^ (k + 1) * c + d, ?_⟩
    have e : (layer q (k + 1) : Int) = ((q + 1 : Nat) : Int) * c - layer q k := by
      have := congrArg (fun t : Nat => (t : Int)) hc; push_cast at this; omega
    rw [e, Int.pow_succ]
    grind

name: MultAdd.Cube.fermat_unit
doc: Fermat for a unit: if p does not divide a, then a^(p−1) ≡ 1.
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ : ∃ q, p = q + 1 := ⟨p - 1, by have := hp.1; omega⟩
  have h := fermat hp a
  unfold MEq at h ⊢
  have e : (a : Int) ^ p - a = (a : Int) * ((a : Int) ^ (p - 1) - 1) := by
    rw [hq, Nat.add_sub_cancel, Int.pow_succ]; grind
  rw [e, Int.ofNat_dvd_left, Int.natAbs_mul, Int.natAbs_natCast] at h
  exact Int.ofNat_dvd_left.mpr (euclid hp ha h)

name: MultAdd.Cube.wilson
doc: **Wilson's theorem (Lagrange 1771).** (p − 1)! ≡ −1 (mod p) for every prime p. Lean's route: inclusion–exclusion on the (p−1)-cube counts the (p−1)! orderings; mod p every layer but the last adds exactly 1, so the count is p − 1 ≡ −1.
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ : ∃ q, p = q + 1 := ⟨p - 1, by have := hp.1; omega⟩
  have hq1 : 1 ≤ q := by have := hp.1; omega
  subst hq
  have hS := S_pow q q (Nat.le_refl q) (q : Int)
  simp only [ite_true] at hS
  rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel, ← hS]
  unfold S
  rw [bsum]
  have hlast : (-1 : Int) ^ q * (layer q q : Int) * ((q : Int) - (q : Nat)) ^ q = 0 := by
    rw [Int.sub_self]
    obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ : ∃ r, q = r + 1 := ⟨q - 1, by omega⟩
    simp [Int.pow_succ]
  rw [hlast, Int.add_zero]
  have hterms : ∀ k, k < q → MEq (q + 1) ((-1 : Int) ^ k * (layer q k : Int) * ((q : Int) - k) ^ q)
      ((fun _ => (1 : Int)) k) := by
    intro k hk
    have h1 := alt_layer hp k (by omega)
    rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel] at h1
    have e : ((q : Int) - (k : Int)) = ((q - k : Nat) : Int) := by
      rw [Int.ofNat_sub (by omega)]
    have h2 := fermat_unit hp (q - k) (by
      intro hd; have := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hd; omega)
    rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel] at h2
    rw [e]
    have := MEq.mul h1 h2
    simpa using this
  have hb := bsum_meq _ _ q hterms
  rw [bsum_one] at hb
  refine MEq.trans hb ⟨1, ?_⟩
  push_cast; omega

name: MultAdd.Cube.dvd_fact
doc: n! divides into every number from 1 to n.
statement: ∀ n d, 1 ≤ d → d ≤ n → d ∣ fact n
proof:
| 0, d, h1, h2 => absurd h2 (by omega)
  | n + 1, d, h1, h2 => by
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge d (n + 1) with h | h
    · exact Nat.dvd_trans (dvd_fact n d h1 (by omega)) ⟨n + 1, by simp [fact, Nat.mul_comm]⟩
    · have : d = n + 1 := by omega
      subst this; exact ⟨fact n, rfl⟩

name: MultAdd.Cube.wilson_iff
doc: **Wilson's test.** For n ≥ 2, (n − 1)! ≡ −1 (mod n) exactly when n is prime.
proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨hn, fun d hd => ?_⟩
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos d with h0 | h0
    · subst h0; rw [Nat.zero_dvd] at hd; omega
    have hdn := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hd
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge d n with hlt | hge
    · have h1 : d ∣ fact (n - 1) := dvd_fact (n - 1) d h0 (by omega)
      have h2 : n ∣ fact (n - 1) + 1 := by
        unfold MEq at h
        have : ((fact (n - 1) : Int) - -1) = ((fact (n - 1) + 1 : Nat) : Int) := by push_cast; omega
        rw [this] at h
        exact Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mp h
      have h3 := (Nat.dvd_add_right h1).mp (Nat.dvd_trans hd h2)
      left; exact Nat.dvd_one.mp h3
    · right; omega
  · intro hp; exact wilson hp

name: MultAdd.Toric.P2.inv_inv'
proof: by grind

name: MultAdd.Toric.P2.inv_ne
proof: by grind

name: MultAdd.Toric.P2.chart_injective
doc: Each chart is injective.
proof:
by
  rcases v with ⟨x, y⟩; rcases w with ⟨x', y'⟩
  cases c <;> simp only [chart] at h
  · simpa using h
  · split at h <;> split at h <;> simp at h <;> grind
  · split at h <;> split at h
    all_goals (try split at h) <;> (try split at h) <;> simp at h
    all_goals grind

name: MultAdd.Toric.P2.chart_cover
doc: The three charts cover P².
statement: ∃ c v, chart c v = p
proof:
by
  rcases p with ⟨a, b⟩ | _ | u
  · exact ⟨c0, (a, b), rfl⟩
  · exact ⟨c2, (0, 0), by simp [chart]⟩
  · exact ⟨c1, (0, u), by simp [chart]⟩

name: MultAdd.Toric.P2.chart_trans
statement: chart d (trans c d v) = chart c v
proof:
by
  rcases v with ⟨x, y⟩
  cases c <;> cases d <;> simp only [Dom, trans, chart] at h ⊢
  all_goals (repeat' split) <;> simp_all <;> grind

name: MultAdd.Toric.P2.inChart_iff
doc: A point of chart c lies in chart d exactly on the transition's domain.
statement: InChart d (chart c v) ↔ Dom c d v
proof:
by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨x', y'⟩, hw⟩
    rcases v with ⟨x, y⟩
    cases c <;> cases d <;> simp only [Dom, chart] at hw ⊢
    all_goals (repeat' split at hw) <;> simp_all <;> grind
  · intro h; exact ⟨_, chart_trans c d v h⟩

name: MultAdd.Toric.P2.trans_cocycle
doc: The cocycle condition, from injectivity: c → d → e equals c → e on the triple overlap.
statement: trans d e (trans c d v) = trans c e v
proof:
by
  have hde : Dom d e (trans c d v) := by
    rw [← inChart_iff, chart_trans c d v hd, inChart_iff]; exact he
  apply chart_injective e
  rw [chart_trans d e _ hde, chart_trans c d v hd, chart_trans c e v he]

name: MultAdd.Toric.P2.origin_in_one_chart
doc: Each chart's origin is one of the three fixed points [0:0:1], [1:0:0], [0:1:0], and it lies in that chart only.
statement: InChart d (chart c ((0 : K), (0 : K))) ↔ d = c
proof:
by
  rw [inChart_iff]; cases c <;> cases d <;> simp [Dom]

name: MultAdd.Toric.P2.torus_in_all
doc: Points of the torus (both coordinates nonzero) lie in all three charts.
proof:
by
  rw [inChart_iff]; cases c <;> cases d <;> simp [Dom, hx, hy]

name: MultAdd.Toric.P2.trans01_multAdd
doc: In mult-add coordinates, the chart change c0 → c1, (a, b) ↦ (1/a, b/a), is (u, w) ↦ (u⁻, w ⊞ u⁻): the mult-add inverse, then a mult-add.
statement: trans c0 c1 (1 + u, 1 + w) = (1 + multAddInv u, 1 + multAdd w (multAddInv u))
proof:
by
  simp only [trans, multAdd, multAddInv, Prod.mk.injEq]; constructor <;> grind

name: MultAdd.Toric.P2.trans02_multAdd
statement: trans c0 c2 (1 + u, 1 + w) = (1 + multAddInv w, 1 + multAdd u (multAddInv w))
proof:
by
  simp only [trans, multAdd, multAddInv, Prod.mk.injEq]; constructor <;> grind

name: MultAdd.Toric.P2.inv_pow'
proof:
by
  induction n with
  | zero => grind
  | succ n ih => rw [Semiring.pow_succ, Semiring.pow_succ, ih]; grind

name: MultAdd.Toric.P2.pow_succ_eq_zero
proof:
by
  induction n with
  | zero => grind
  | succ n ih => rw [Semiring.pow_succ]; grind

name: MultAdd.Toric.P2.trans_wind
doc: Windings commute with every chart change: monomial maps commute with x ↦ xⁿ.
statement: trans c d (pw n v) = pw n (trans c d v)
proof:
by
  rcases v with ⟨x, y⟩
  cases c <;> cases d <;> simp [trans, pw, inv_pow', mul_pow']

name: MultAdd.Toric.P2.chart_wind
doc: So the winding is one well-defined map of P², read the same way in every chart.
statement: chart c (pw (n + 1) v) = wind (n + 1) (chart c v)
proof:
by
  rcases v with ⟨x, y⟩
  cases c
  · rfl
  · by_cases hx : x = 0 <;> simp [chart, pw, wind, hx, pow_succ_eq_zero, inv_pow', mul_pow']
  · by_cases hx : x = 0 <;> by_cases hy : y = 0 <;>
      simp [chart, pw, wind, hx, hy, pow_succ_eq_zero, inv_pow', mul_pow']

name: MultAdd.Toric.P2.fan_count
proof: by grind

name: MultAdd.Toric.corner_all_on
doc: The top corner (all switches on) is the torus.
statement: (∀ i, corner v i = true) ↔ ∀ i, v i ≠ 0
proof:
by
  simp [corner]

name: MultAdd.Toric.corner_scale
doc: Scaling by the torus (nonzero factors) never moves a point to another corner, so the corners label the torus orbits.
statement: corner (fun i => t i * v i) = corner v
proof:
by
  funext i
  have hti := ht i
  have key : t i * v i = 0 ↔ v i = 0 := by
    constructor
    · intro h; grind
    · intro h; rw [h]; grind
  simp [corner, key]

name: MultAdd.Toric.chart1_injective
proof:
by
  cases b with
  | false => simpa [chart1] using h
  | true =>
    simp only [chart1] at h
    by_cases hx : x = 0 <;> by_cases hy : y = 0 <;> simp [hx, hy] at h
    · rw [hx, hy]
    · have : x = (x⁻¹)⁻¹ := by grind
      rw [this, h]; grind

name: MultAdd.Toric.chart1_cover
doc: The two charts cover P¹.
statement: ∃ b x, chart1 b x = p
proof:
by
  cases p with
  | none => exact ⟨true, 0, by simp [chart1]⟩
  | some x => exact ⟨false, x, rfl⟩

name: MultAdd.Toric.torus_in_both
doc: Points of the circle (nonzero, finite) lie in both charts.
proof:
by
  cases b with
  | false => exact ⟨x, rfl⟩
  | true =>
    refine ⟨x⁻¹, ?_⟩
    have h1 : x⁻¹ ≠ 0 := by grind
    have h2 : (x⁻¹)⁻¹ = x := by grind
    simp [chart1, h1, h2]

name: MultAdd.Toric.origin_in_one_chart
doc: The origin of chart c lies in chart c and in no other chart.
statement: InChart1 d (chart1 c (0 : K)) ↔ d = c
proof:
by
  cases c <;> cases d <;> simp only [InChart1, chart1] <;> simp
  intro x hx h
  have : x * x⁻¹ = 1 := Field.mul_inv_cancel hx
  rw [h] at this; grind

name: MultAdd.Toric.chart1_trans
statement: chart1 d (trans1 c d x) = chart1 c x
proof:
by
  cases c <;> cases d <;> simp [trans1, chart1]
  · have hx := h (by decide)
    have h1 : x⁻¹ ≠ 0 := by grind
    have h2 : (x⁻¹)⁻¹ = x := by grind
    simp [h1, h2]
  · have hx := h (by decide)
    simp [hx]

name: MultAdd.Toric.chart2_injective
proof:
by
  simp only [chart2, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
  have h1 := chart1_injective c.1 v.1 w.1 h.1
  have h2 := chart1_injective c.2 v.2 w.2 h.2
  cases v; cases w; simp_all

name: MultAdd.Toric.chart2_cover
doc: The four charts cover P¹ × P¹.
statement: ∃ c v, chart2 c v = p
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨b1, x1, h1⟩ := chart1_cover p.1
  obtain ⟨b2, x2, h2⟩ := chart1_cover p.2
  exact ⟨(b1, b2), (x1, x2), by simp [chart2, h1, h2]⟩

name: MultAdd.Toric.inChart2_iff
statement: InChart2 c p ↔ InChart1 c.1 p.1 ∧ InChart1 c.2 p.2
proof:
by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v, hv⟩
    rw [← hv]; exact ⟨⟨v.1, rfl⟩, ⟨v.2, rfl⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, ⟨y, hy⟩⟩
    exact ⟨(x, y), by simp [chart2, hx, hy]⟩

name: MultAdd.Toric.torus_in_all
doc: Points of the torus lie in all four charts.
proof: (inChart2_iff c _).2 ⟨torus_in_both x hx c.1, torus_in_both y hy c.2⟩

name: MultAdd.Toric.fixed_point_in_one_chart
doc: Each chart's origin is one of the four fixed points, and it lies in that chart only.
statement: InChart2 d (chart2 c ((0 : K), (0 : K))) ↔ d = c
proof:
by
  rw [inChart2_iff]
  simp only [chart2, origin_in_one_chart]
  cases c; cases d; simp

name: MultAdd.Toric.chart2_trans
doc: Where two charts overlap, the transition carries one chart's coordinates to the other's.
statement: chart2 d (trans2 c d v) = chart2 c v
proof:
by
  simp [chart2, trans2, chart1_trans c.1 d.1 v.1 h1, chart1_trans c.2 d.2 v.2 h2]

name: MultAdd.Toric.trans1_cocycle
doc: The cocycle condition: c → d → e equals c → e, so the gluing is consistent on every triple overlap.
statement: trans1 d e (trans1 c d x) = trans1 c e x
proof:
by
  cases c <;> cases d <;> cases e <;> simp [trans1] <;> grind

name: MultAdd.Toric.trans2_cocycle
statement: trans2 d e (trans2 c d v) = trans2 c e v
proof:
by
  simp [trans2, trans1_cocycle]

name: MultAdd.Toric.fan_count
doc: With a = q - 1 points on the circle: one torus (a²), four circles (a each), four fixed points. In ordinary coordinates it is (q + 1)².
proof: by grind
